tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa lha dgu'i rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg cho ga 'chi med lha'i ba

dan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa lha dgu'i rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg cho ga 'chi med lha'i ba dan zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam kun mchog ldan stong nyid me dpung gis// ma rig 'thib po'i las nyon kun bsregs te// tshe dpal byang chub sems dang sa lam gyi// yon tan rgyas mdzad lha der gus phyag 'tshal// 'dir tshe dpag med pa lha dgu'i dkyil chog slob dpon chen po dze ta ri dgra las rnam rgyal gyi rjes su 'brang ba rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga la sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum gyi/ dang po ni/ tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor rdul tshon ras bris gang rung bshams pa sogs mthong ba brgyud pa ltar byas te/ bdag mdun bum pa bdag 'jug sogs dang bsnyen pa ci 'grub byas la/ gnas yid dang mthun par sa'i stegs bu dpangs sor brgyad pa rgyar khru do'am phyed yod pa dri bzang dang tshon rtsi ser po dang*/ ba'i rnam lngas byugs pa'i dbus su rgyas pa'i thab khung ni spros pa la dga' na/ stegs bu'i dbus su tshe dpag med pa'i dkyil 'khor rdul tshon nam ras bris gang rung bkod pa'i phyir/ rgyas pa'i thab rim pa gsum gyi kha khyer mchu dang bcas pa/ kha khyer la rin po che'i phreng bas bskor ba'i phyi'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rin po ches spras pa bris pa la/ zhal khebs dang bcas pa'i steng du rdo'am 'jim pa'i brtsigs thab dpangs su bskums khru gang dang rgyar nang gi ngos bzhir rtse khru re re yod pa kha khyer mchu dang bcas pa/ rtsig pa'i nang du 'o ma can gyi shing gi sked pa'i cha las byung ba'i dkyus su khru gang ba/ sbom du chag gang ba mnyam par bcad pa/ zho dang 'o ma mngar gsum dang*/ dri bzang dang tshon ser pos kha bsgyur bas dam du brtsegs shing shar lho'i dbus su me tshang yang bca'o// thab kyi phyi ngos la tshon ser po dri bzang pos legs par byug go// de nas g.yas ngos su gong gi bud shing gi rgyu de nyid las byung ba'i yam shing sor nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/

sbom mthe bong dang mnyam pa/ rtse mo gnyis mnyam par bcad pa rtsa rtse zho/ 'o ma/ bu ram/ sbrang*/ ka ra/ dri bzang*/ til mar dag tshon ser po byug pa dang*/ gzhan yang til dang*/ yungs kar dang*/ dur ba dang*/ 'bras dkar po dang*/ zas mchog dang*/ ku sha dang*/ so ba dang*/ nas dang*/ gro dang*/ sran ma dang*/ shing thog rnam pa sna tshogs pa rnams go rim ma log par snod so sor bkod de legs par bshams/ de'i nang ngam phyi ngos su me lha'i mchod pa dang*/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga dang*/ gos zung ser po dang*/ gtor ma rnams bshams/ nye logs kyi mdun du'am g.yas su mar khu mdog ser po dri bzang gis sbags pa dang*/ a ru ra/ sgog skya/ ga pur/ gi waṃ/ gla rtsi/ sbrang rtsi/ bu ram/ ka ra sogs sbyar ba la rdo thal med pa'i so rtsi rnams bshams shing*/ rang gi g.yas su rdor dril/ las bum/ dgang blugs/ rlung g.yab/ ku sha sogs nyer mkho rnams bshams/ g.yon phyogs su 'das pa'i me lha'i mchod pa dung chos sam/ gser gyi snod dang gzed zhal sogs kyi chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod dang*/ gtor ma/ gos zung ser po rnams bshams/ gzhan yang nyer mkho rnams ni mthong brgyud ltar bshams ste go rim ma log cing bkod legs par bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ sgrub pa po gos dang rgyan ser po byas la/ khri'i steng du bzang po'i 'dug stangs dga' zhing byams pa'i sems kyis 'dug ste/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭa hoḥ zhes rdor dril bzung la las sngags brjod/ las bum gyi chus thab la bsang gtor byas la/ me lha'i mchod pa spyi 'gro ltar byin gyis brlabs nas ku sha'i chun po rnams/ oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ zhes bdun bzlas/ ku sha rtse mo ma nyams pa gnyis gnyis gshib la/ g.yas ngos nas thab kyi kha khyer la rtse mo byang phyogs nas brtsams te snga ma'i rtsa ba phyi ma'i rtse mos non par bkram zhing che ba gnyis ba glang gi rna ba'i rnam par byas pa rtse mo byang du bstan te thab kyi steng du g.yogs shing*/

oṃ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge// tshangs pa lha rnams dag byed yin// dkon mchog gsum po mnyes byed pa// sa la skyes pa 'dab ma'i snying*// bdag gi bgegs rnams thams cad ni// zhi dang bkra shis mdzad du gsol// swā hā badz+ra satwa āḥ zhes brjod/ de nas rgyu snga ma lta bu ku sha dang lhan cig tu nags la me shor ba'am/ me shel las byung ba'i me sbar ba me tshang du bcug la/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod la rlung g.yab kyis me sbar zhing las sngags brjod/ blugs gzar gyis mar khu lan bdun gyis sreg blugs 'bul zhing las sngags brjod/ de nas thab dang me bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun bskyed hūm̐ las byung ba'i rgyas pa'i thab khung gru bzhi ser po mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa kha khyer la rin po che'i phreng bas brgyan cing mchu 'phyang ba/ zur bzhir zla phyed rin po ches brgyan pa'i dbus su raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa rab tu 'bar ba/ de'i dbus su oṃ las pad+ma'i steng du raṃ las bgrang phreng las skyes pa'i me lha sku mdog ser po rgyas pa'i nyams can zhal bzhi pa spyan gsum dang ldan zhing*/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis mchod sbyin dang bgrang phreng*/ g.yon gnyis spyi blugs dang dbyug gu 'dzin pa gsus pa 'phyang zhing ral pa'i tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ gnyug mar gnas pa'i rig ma dang gnyis su med pa/ khro bo'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing*/ g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor bar gyur/ de nas 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgyas/ hūm̐ ṭa ki dzaḥhūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka nas khro bo 'dod rgyal spros te shar lho nas me lha 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ g.yas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgyas mthe bong g.yab cing g.yon dril bu gsil bas/ oṃ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che// lha yi drang srong bram ze mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du//

'dir ni yang dag bsnyen par mdzod// ces brjod/ me lha 'khor bcas byon nas thabs kyi kha khyer la ku sha'i stan la bzhugs par gyur/ ces mos/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ gis bgegs bskrad cing*/ oṃ āḥhrīḥpra wa ra sat+kā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐/ pā d+yaṃ hūm̐ oṃ/ zhes chu gnyis phul la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis su med par gyur| ces mos la/ lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa rtse gsum gyi phyag rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra ā na la ma hā bhū ta dz+wa la ya/ sarba bhasmin ku ru sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ hūm̐ phaṭa dṛ sh+ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya hoḥ zhes gsum gyis dam la bzhag /dbang bskur ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas dbang lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ ces mos la/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ṭa kis dbang bskur bas// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsregs// 'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces bstod nas lag g.yon rin po che'i khu tshur kha brgyan pas dgang gzar mar gyis bkang ba bzung ba'i khar/ g.yas rin po che'i khu tshur gyis blugs gzar mar gyis bkang ba kha steng du bstan pa bzhag cing*/ lag gnyis rdor dril dang dus nam yang mi 'bral zhing*/ gru mo gnyis pus mo las phyir mi 'da' bar bya ba ni dbu zhabs kun tu 'gre'o// me lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags dang dgang blugs kyi kha la ram̐ yig gis mtshan par gyur/

zhes dmigs te/ g.yas skor du dgang blugs dbul zhing*/ oṃ ag+na ye a dī bya a dī bya a bi sha ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya bā ha na ya swā hā/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ oṃ ag+na ye bdag gi tshe dpal 'byor pa sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ zhes dgang blugs gsum mam/ lnga'am/ bdun gyis phul/ me pra brtags te 'di'i tshul gzhan du shes par bya zhing*/ ngan par mthong na las sngags bzla zhing las bum gyi chus bsang gtor bya/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i sngags la bhū ta sarba shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes dgang blugs bdun me lha la 'bul/ slar las sngags kyi chus bsang gtor byas te/ me lha'i sngags ring thung gis dgang blugs bdun dbul/ me pra bzang na de dag mi dgos so// de nas las sngags kyi bsang chus sreg rdzas rnams bsangs la/ oṃ swā hās rdzas rnams bkrus la/ oṃ āḥswā hās yam shing dang*/ oṃ shrīṃ swā hās zhun mar dang*/ oṃ dz+riṃ swā hās 'bru rnams dang*/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hās rdzas lhag ma rnams mtshan nyid dang mi ldan pa'i skyon sbyangs nas bdud rtsi'i ngo bor bsam la/ yam shing zung du sbyar ba byang chub kyi shing du mos shing*/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ye swā hā/ bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor thams cad dang khyad par gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ zhes me lha'i sngags la sbyar ba'am/ ma sbyar yang rung 'bul lo// de bzhin mar khu la/ oṃ ag+ne ye bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor dang khyad par 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ sreg rdzas kyi go rim 'di'i skabs kyi mar khu ni blugs gzar rkyang pas 'bul bar bshad kyang sreg blugs dang dgang blugs ci bder 'bul lo// blugs gzar mar gyis bkang nas 'bul ba sreg blugs yin zhing*/ dgang gzar mar gyis bkang ba'i steng du blugs gzar mar gyis bkang ste sbrag nas gcig nas gcig tu brgyud par phul ba ni dgang blugs te 'di'i khyad par shes dgos so// deng sang sbyin sreg gi slob dpon byed pa 'gas ni/

sreg blugs dang*/ dgang blugs kyi khyad par mi shes pa nongs par zad do// de nas/ til la/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na ya bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor thams cad dang*/ khyad par sdig pa'i gnyen po phun sum tshogs pa sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ yungs kar la/ oṃ sarba ar+tha sid+dhi ya bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor dang*/ khyad par bgegs kyi gnyen po phun sum tshogs pa sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ durba la/ oṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor thams cad dang*/ khyad par tshe phun sum tshogs pa sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ 'bras la/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor thams cad dang*/ khyad par dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ zas mchog la/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor thams cad dang*/ khyad par dge ba phun sum tshogs pa sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ ku sha la/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ye bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor thams cad dang*/ khyad par srung ba phun sum tshogs pa sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ so ba la/ oṃ badz+ra bi dza ye bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor thams cad dang*/ khyad par nor dang 'bru phun sum tshogs pa sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ| nas la/ oṃ ma hā be ga ye bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor thams cad dang*/ khyad par myur ba'i shugs phun sum tshogs pa sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ gro la/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma ri ye bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor thams cad dang*/ khyad par nad med pa phun sum tshogs pa sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ sran ma la/ oṃ ma hā ba la ye bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal 'byor thams cad dang*/ khyad par lus kyi stobs phun sum tshogs pa sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ shing tog sna tshogs la/ oṃ ga gā ni ga gā ni bi lo ki te hūm̐ phaṭa/ bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor thams cad dang*/

khyad par rigs rgyud phun sum tshogs pa sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ zhes sngags dang phyag rgya bcas 'bul zhing*/ de yang yam shing dang ku sha durba rnams kyi rtse mo lha la phyogs pas 'bul/ rdzas lag pas bzung sla ba rnams lag pa'i mtheb srin gyis mchod sbyin byas te dbul/ kha cig gis blugs gzar gyis 'bul bar bshad pa'ang 'gal ba mi snang ngo*/ /zhu ba'i rdzas rnams zhal dang*/ yam shing ku sha durba spos sogs 'od kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ bza' ba dang 'bru rnams phyag dang*/ mchod yon dang mar me mdun/ zhabs bsil zhabs dang*/ bsang gtor sku/ me tog dbu/ dri thugs kar/ rol mo snyan du dbul bar dmigs so// de nas chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod la/ oṃ/ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ri ṣi mchog /'byung po yongs su bskyab pa'i phyir// thugs rje'i dbang gis skur sprul pa// rig sngags grub pa'i drang srong tshul// nyon mongs bsregs pa'i shes rab 'od// mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan// phyag bzhi mi 'jigs bgrang phreng dang*// dbyug gu bdud rtsi'i kuṇ+ḍi bsnams// zhal nas grub pa'i rig sngags gsung*// nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod// 'jig rten la gnas mya ngan 'das// zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che// de la bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// zhes bstod/ de nas 'das pa'i me lha ni/ me lha'i thugs kar hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba dra ba zhes pa nas/ gtso 'khor thams cad 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur gyi bar/ tshe dpag lha dgu'i dkyil chog ngor pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i phyogs bsgrigs mdun bskyed ltar sgom pa'am/ yang na dkyil 'khor dang 'brel na gzhal yas khang gdan bcas skad cig gis bskyed la lha so so'i sngags brjod cing me tog dor/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod la lha rnams rang rang gi gdan la bzhugs par mos shing*/

mchod pa rnams gzhung ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na// zhes sogs kyi tshig sbyar ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mos mchod nas/ chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen bskor// zhes pa nas/ tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstod la/ lha'i ljags la rang gi mdog can gyi rdo rje'i sbu gu can la ram̐ yig dgang blugs kyi khar hrīḥyig dmar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa gsal bar gyur par dmigs te/ gtso bo'i snying po la spel tshig sngar ltar sbyar ba'i dgang blugs gsum mam/ lnga'am/ bdun gyis phul la/ dngos grub ci 'dod pa stsol bar zhal gyis bzhes par gyur ces mos/ de nas sreg rdzas rnams/ yam shing nas shing tog sna tshogs kyi bar sngar ltar 'bul zhing*/ dang po dbus kyi bud+dha tshe dpag med la snying po'i sngags kyi mthar rdzas sngags spel tshig can sbyar te brgya rtsa sogs dang*/ de nas rdo rje tshe dpag med nas g.yas skor du 'khor gyi lha rnams la nyer gcig sogs rang rang gi snying po dang rdzas sngags spel tshig sbyar bas phul/ bsdus na/ gtso bo la nyer gcig sogs dang*/ 'khor rnams thun mong du mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i gzungs ring gis lnga'am bdun 'bul/ shin tu bsdus pa ltar na/ gtso 'khor thams cad thun mong du gzungs ring gis gsum mam/ lnga'am/ bdun nam/ nyer gcig sogs dbul bar bya zhing*/ spel tshig rnams thams cad la sbyor mi nus kyang re re'i thog mthar sbyar te dbul/ dbul ba'i tshig rnams dang dmigs pa ni me lha'i skabs ji lta ba bzhin no// rdzas phul nas phrin las bcol ba'i tshe/ mdun gyi lha'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i sangs rgyas rnams tshe dpag med pa longs sku'i cha lugs kyis byon te/ phyag tu tshe'i bum pa ser po bsnams nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun ser po'i bdag la dbang bskur bas/ bdag gi tshe dpal bsod nams dang sa lam gyi yon tan rgyas par bsam/

de nas sreg rdzas rnams rdzogs par phul ba'i mjug tu/ oṃ badz+ra ā yur+dz+nyā na sti ra bha ga wa te ag+na ye sid+dhi puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ zhes pas dgang blugs bdun phul nas/ oṃ badz+ra tam+bu la ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes so rtsi dang*/ sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra zhing*// zhes sho lo ka gcig dang*/ oṃ badz+ra wa sa s+ya swā hā/ zhes pas gos zung 'bul/ gtor ma spyi 'gro ltar byin gyis brlabs te/ oṃ na mo bh+rūṃ a yur+dz+nyā na hrīḥ.oṃ ā ro lika hūm̐ sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro sogs gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul/ de nas chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mos mchod la/ bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang rung gis bstod/ gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis// ces sho lo ka gcig dang yi ge brgya pas bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod// ces sho lo ka gcig dang*/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa rnams gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang la thim par gyur/ ces mos la/ slar me lha'i gtang rag ni las sngags brjod cing*/ bsang gtor gyis thab dang rdzas rnams bsangs/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes sreg blugs gcig phul te| me lha me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus su gsal ba slar yang gzi brjid ches cher 'bar bar gyur ces dmigs/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mos mchod la/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// zhes sho lo ka gcig gis bstod la/ me lha'i sngags kyis dgang blugs bdun phul nas/ slar yang yam shing nas shing thog gi bar rdzas rnams me lha'i skabs ltar mang nyung ci 'byor phul/ oṃ badz+ra tam+bu la ye āḥhūm̐ gis so rtsi dang*/ oṃ badz+ra wa sa s+ya swā hā/ zhes gos zung phul nas gtor ma spyi 'gro ltar byin gyis brlabs/ me lha'i sngags la a kā ro btags pa lan gsum dang*/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la| |zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// ces pa'i bar gyis gtor ma phul nas/

slar dgang blugs lan gsum me lha'i sngags kyis phul/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i sngags kyis sreg blugs gcig phul bas me lha gzi brjid dang ldan par bsam/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mos mchod/ me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha// zhes sho lo ka gcig gis bstod/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis nongs pa bshags/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// sgrub byed bsreg bya za ba gshegs// ji lta'i dus su slar 'byon la// bdag gi don kun 'grub par mdzod// oṃ badz+ra muḥ me lha ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang nyid la thim par gyur/ ces dmigs la/ bsngo ba dang*/ smon lam/ bkra shis sogs rgyas par bya'o// de nas dri bzang gi chu mdog ser pos me gzhil te/ thal sol rnams mdzod du sba ba'am/ lam gyi gzhi mdor/ mchod rten nam/ khang bu byas la bzhag par bya'o// lar sbyin sreg gi dbu nas mjug gi bar du me sol rnams dkrug pa dang*/ phu gdab pa dang*/ sbyin sreg gi mes las gzhan bya ba dang*/ thal sol stor ba sogs tshul ma yin pa'i spyod pa spangs la bag yod par bya/ me'ang long yod na rang zhir btang*/ med na dri'i chu ser pos gzhil te gong du bshad pa bzhin bya/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod bstod/ gshegs bsdu sogs chog gzhung ltar bya zhing las kyi rjes mi mngon par byas/ las bum gyi chus sgrub khang gi phyi nang kun tu bsang gtor bya zhing*/ sbyin sreg gi tshul 'di mtha' gcod dang bsal bya sogs rgyas pa ni gzhan du shes par bya'o// lar sbyin sreg dang rab gnas dbang bskur sogs kyi slob dpon du 'os pa ni rgyud kyi tshul rnams shes shing dbang mnos pa/ bsnyen pa thems pa/ slob dpon mkhas pa'i lag len thos pa/ bla ma dang lha'i gnang ba thob pa dag gis bya'i/ gzhan nor mang shing dbang che ba'i rgan rabs rmongs pa'i tshig gi rgyun la chags pa dag gis rang bzo bya ba'i dus gnas ni dus nam yang ma yin no/

/swa sti/ bdud rtsi'i 'od stong ut+pal gzhon nu'i sgra// snang byed 'od kyi do shal ngom bzhin du// 'dab brgya bzhad pa nam mkha'i nor bu 'di// sna tshogs gar gyis nam mkhar rol ba'i tshe// rmad byung dga' bas myos pa'i skad gsang can| |dbyar skyes dbang po gad rgyang sgrog bzhin du// mdangs mdzes nags kyi gar mkhan yid sangs nas// sgyu rtsal rol rtsed 'jo ba'i dpal du bgyis// de ltar tshe dpag med lha dgu'i rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'jigs med lha'i ba dan zhes bya ba 'di/ dus kyi pho nya'i lo khrum stod kyi zla ba'i tshes klu gzugs kyi dus dge ba'i char/ rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i don rtogs shing dpyad pa la bsnyengs pa med pa'i dge slong chos kyi grags pas dpal zla dgon gyi chos grwa chen po'i dbus rnam gnon tshul khrims kyi gtsug lag khang chen por sbyar ba'o// //maṅga laṃ//
